verses.en: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
verses.sm: Atua ma le Alii o Iesu Keriso, O ou alofa atu i itu apa e sefulu ma le lua ua faasalalauina.

verses.en: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
verses.sm: Oku uso e, ia outou manatu, o le mea e fiafia tele ai pe a maua outou i tofotofoga eseese;

verses.en: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
verses.sm: ina ua outou iloa o le tofotofoina o lo outou faatuatua e tupu ai le onosai.

verses.en: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
verses.sm: la atoatoa foi le galuega a le onosai, ina ia atoatoa ai ma ia sao ona lelei ai outou, ia leai se mea e tasi e mativa ai.

verses.en: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.sm: A e afai ua leai se poto i so outou, ina ole atu ia i le Atua, o le foai tele mai i tagata uma ma le le toe ta‘uta‘ua; ona foaiina mai ai lea ia te ia.

verses.en: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
verses.sm: A ia ole atu ma le faatuatua, aua lava neʻi masalosalo; auā o lē masalosalo e tusa ia ma le peau o le sami ua sousou i le matagi ma felafolafoaiina.

verses.en: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
verses.sm: Aua lava neʻi manatu lea tagata na te maua se mea e tasi mai le Alii;

verses.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
verses.sm: o le tagata faalotolotolua e faaletumau ia i ona ala uma.

verses.en: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
verses.sm: Ia olioli le uso mativa ina ua faamaualugaina o ia;

verses.en: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.sm: a o le mauoa ia olioli o ia ina ua faamaulaloina; aua e mavae atu ia pei o fuga o laau;

verses.en: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
verses.sm: auā pe a alu ae le la ma le vevela, ona mamae ai lea o le vao, ua malili foi lona fuga, ma ua faaumatia lona matagofie; e faapea foi ona mavae atu o le tagata mauoa i ona ala.

verses.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verses.sm: Amuia le tagata o lē onosai i le faaosoosoga; aua a uma ona tofotofoina e mauz e ia le pale o le ola, ua folafolaina mai e le Alii i e alolofa atu ia te ia.

verses.en: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
verses.sm: A faaosoosoina se tasi, aua le faapea, “Ua faaosoosoina aʻu mai le Atua,” auā e le mafai ona faaosoosoina o le Atua i mea leaga, e le faaosooso atu foi o ia i se tasi;

verses.en: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
verses.sm: a ua taitasi ma faaosoosoina, pe a tosina ma maileia i lona lava tuʻinanau.

verses.en: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
verses.sm: Pe a to le tu‘inanau ona fanau mai ai lea o le agasala; a matua le agasala ona fanaua mai ai lea o le oti.

verses.en: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
verses.sm: Oʻu uso pele e, aua neʻi sese outou.

verses.en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.sm: O mea lelei uma e foaifuaina mai, atoa ma mea alofa uma e atoatoa ona lelei, mai lugā lava ia, e alu ifo mai le Tamā o malamalama, e le o ia te ia se mea faaletumau, po o sina liliu itiiti.

verses.en: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.sm: O lona finagalo na fanau ai i tatou i le upu moni, ina ia fai i tatou e pei o faapolopolo o ana lava mea na fai.

verses.en: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.sm: O lenei, oʻu uso pele e, ia taitasi le tagata ma faataalise ona faalogologo, ia faagesegese ona tautala atu, ia faagesegese ona ita.

verses.en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
verses.sm: Aua e le tupu le amiotonu mai le Atua i le ita o tagata.

verses.en: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.sm: O lea foi ia lafoai ai mea eleelea uma ma le leaga e silisili, ia talia ma le faamaulalo le upu ua totóina, o lea e mafai ai ona faaolaina o outou agaga.

verses.en: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.sm: A ia fai outou ma e anaana i le upu, a e aua le na ona faalogologo i ai, o faaseseina ai outou e outou.

verses.en: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
verses.sm: Aua ai se tasi e faalogologo i le upu a e le anaana i ai, e tusa ia ma le tagata ua vaavaai i le faaata i ona lava mata na fanau ma ia;

verses.en: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.sm: aua ua vaavaai O ia ia te ia, ona alu ese lea, ua galo loa le uiga o ona mata.

verses.en: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
verses.sm: A o lë matuā matamata i le tulafono o le sáolotoga ua atoatoz ona lelei, ma ua tumau i ai O ia, e le se faalogologo ma le faagalogalo lena tagata, a o le anaana i le galuega, e manuia o ia i lona lava anaana.

verses.en: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
verses.sm: Ai se tasi o ia te outou e manatu ifo o ia o le tagata toaga i lotu, a e le taofi i lana upu, a e faaseseina e ia lona lava loto, ua le aoga lona toaga i lotu.

verses.en: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
verses.sm: O lenei lava le toaga i lotu e lelei ma le faamaoni i luma o le Atua o le Tamà lea, ina ia tauasiasi atu i e mátua oti ma fafine ua oti a latou tane i o latou tiga, ia leol
